name: Status Quo Bias
axiom: People keep the option they already have unless something forces a change.
trigger: A setting nobody changed is treated as the one people chose.

checklist.text: Name the default in words and say what happens if nobody chooses.
Make any move away from the default reversible in one step.
Give the alternatives the same visibility as the default; do not bury them.

antiPattern.violation: Opt-out sits on a second screen, so the default is the only path anyone finds.
antiPattern.remediation: Show the default and the alternative on one screen, equally visible, both one click away.

parametricParams.caption: THE DEFAULT IS WHAT PEOPLE KEEP

academicOrigin.title: Status quo bias in decision making
